open_points.subject: Repeated confirmation after the same session accepted the import
open_points.text: “A confirmation refused because the closure exists — made by any import accepted before it, of another session or of this one” conflicts with “Stage (1) comes first — the session, the CSRF value and the confirmation value, used up when it was carried (A13 rule 6)”
open_points.question: When the same session resubmits the confirmation that already accepted the import, is it refused at stage (1) because its one-time confirmation value is gone, or because the migration closure exists?
options: Refuse at stage (1) as a missing or already-used confirmation value, without reaching the closure check
Refuse because the closure created by the session's preceding accepted submission exists
open_points.default_guess: Apply A13 and the stated stage order: refuse at stage (1) because the confirmation value was already used.

witness.initial: One owner session has an uploaded file and a valid pending import confirmation; no migration closure exists.
events: The owner submits the valid confirmation; Registry consumes it, accepts the import, writes the closure and drops all uploads, but the response is lost.
The owner resubmits the same confirmation form in the same session.
outcomes: A13 and the stated stage order refuse the resubmission at stage (1), because the pending confirmation value was consumed.
The changed outcome’s “of this one” clause refuses the resubmission because the closure created by that session's accepted import exists.
witness.observer: The owner sees which refusal occurred, and later State 5 implementers must assign different failure semantics to the response.
